title: CoverUp: Effective High Coverage Test Generation for Python
venue: Proceedings of the ACM on software engineering.
datasets: CM 425 modules/35 projects derived from BugsInPy evaluation subjects (not BugsInPy bug-version dataset); PY 84 modules; MT 163 HumanEval functions.
models: OpenAI GPT-4o-2024-05-13; temperature 0; configurable alternatives in code
input_setting: Uncovered source segments + coverage feedback + get_info source retrieval; generated tests run against current source
reproduction_grade: B (conditional exact model cost; cached results available)
limitation: CM was derived from subjects used in prior BugsInPy studies, not historical BugsInPy bug instances. No Defects4J/SWT bug reproduction, no root-cause diagnosis, and no oracle-strength metric. Full LLM replay is expensive.
task: Coverage-guided Python regression test generation with iterative repair
